In the combinatorial matrix of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text examines the conditional relations arising from the synthesis of the triad on visible phenomena (*Sanidassanattika*) and the dyad regarding root conditions and phenomena possessing root conditions (*Hetusahetukaduka*) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral catalogs the text as an individual leaf division without a standalone English title [SuttaCentral].
